newsitem.title: DUBAI: Sharjah Jan-Sep airfreight up 19pc, stable in Sept.
newsitem.headline: Sharjah Jan-Sep airfreight up 19pc, stable in Sept.

text.p: Sharjah airport said cargo volumes were stable in September at a similar level to those in the same month in 1995, but tonnages handled in the first nine months of 1996 were sharply higher than in the same period last year.
Almost 26,725 tonnes passed through the airport in the month, from 26,580 tonnes in September 1995. This was lower than the almost 28,398 tonnes handled in August this year.
Sea-air freight exports rose 11 percent to 2,651 tonnes from 2,384 tonnes the previous September.
In the first nine months of this year, air cargo volumes rose nearly 19 percent to 226,870 tonnes.
Sea-air freight tonnages were up 55 percent in the January to September 1996 period at 24,658.
